reviews.text: I’ve made this business card five times tonight. The app is not saving the information when I tell it to, and then when I go to Preview the card it’s wrong. I fix it, then I scan from another phone and the card is still the same as it was the first time this is absolutely ridiculous.

reviews.title: Deceptive
reviews.text: Liked this app before, however, they send you a “write us a review for a $20 amazon gift card” email and do not follow through at all. You have to make an account on an external site and write them a fairly detailed review only to never hear back about said gift card.  Unprofessional.

reviews.title: Google Sign-in error
reviews.text:
I’m using an iPhone 16 Pro Max on the latest Apple software iOS 26.5 Every time I try to sign in with my Gmail/Google account the app immediately crashes. I’ve tried multiple times and still can’t get past the login screen.

Please fix the Google sign in issue. I’d be happy to update my review once the app works properly.
